name: MORI
author: L'Cronx
summary: A love letter to MEMENTO | Enjoy-Lab, own code. A tempo-synced DUB loop, stereo tempo delay, multi-head, grain and vinyl TEXTURE memory, shimmer reverb, bipolar filter and master FX on a 14-way routing matrix. Two 16-step modulators, a three-zone touch bar, a browser editor, 69 presets plus your own. MPC OS 3.x.
